description: Google Maps API: List place reviews. Reviews of a place with rating, text, translation, date and owner response. Price: 3 credits per call; failed calls are free. Paginated: pass pagination.next_cursor as `cursor` for the next page (each page is a new call).

limit.description: Reviews per page (max 20, one page of the source)

place_id.description: Place ID, CID or feature ID

name: maps_place_reviews
title: List place reviews
